## Definition of Done (PRD §23)

- [ ] Functional requirements implemented
- [ ] Responsive at mobile / tablet / laptop / desktop / large desktop
- [ ] Loading, empty, error and network-failure states
- [ ] Works against DummyJSON and/or local fixtures
- [ ] Form/input validation where applicable
- [ ] Accessibility (keyboard, focus, labels, live regions, contrast)
- [ ] At least one automated test for the happy path
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] README / docs updated
- [ ] Verified on the deployed preview
